themes.title: R1 scored trajectory is conditional evidence for complementary text features
themes.lesson: Across the scored R1 nodes, word and character TF-IDF variants followed by calibrated probability ensembles produced conditional improvements on this fixed split. R2 should retrieve the trajectory as a search prior while refitting every vectorizer and model from its own fit data.
themes.alternative: Prefer a small self-contained change and verify train, reload and Host scoring before keeping it.

themes.title: R1 stopped after repeated train/predict serialization failures
themes.lesson: The final three R1 candidates trained but failed in predict1 because their model list exceeded the serialized vectorizer list. The frozen harness stopped after three consecutive non-transient failures; R2 should treat this as an engineering guardrail and explicitly check model/vectorizer cardinality.
themes.alternative: Keep the original incumbent, require a reload smoke test inside the candidate, and avoid adding channels without adding matching preprocessing objects.
